name: Great Novel Therapeutics Biotech & Medicals
summary: Great Novel Therapeutics Biotech & Medicals specializes in crafting pharmaceutical solutions to combat advanced and treatment-resistant cancers. Their primary focus lies in the realm of cancer immunotherapy, encompassing the creation of compounds such as tumor microenvironment regulators, epigenetic immunoactivators, and immune-regulating multi-kinase inhibitors. The company was previously known as GNT Biotech & Medicals Corporation. Established in 2013, its headquarters are situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.
